explication: Cap provides a browser CAPTCHA widget backed by proof-of-work and instrumentation, plus a standalone server for challenge verification and administration. The principal flow is a visitor’s widget requesting a challenge, solving it in a worker, and submitting a result for server-side validation; the standalone dashboard and configuration APIs are a separate operational branch. Some key modules are present in the tree but their source was not sampled, so uncertain internal connections are omitted.
